# Flint Digital

> Kansas City based, AI-first digital agency for small businesses. We build hand-coded websites and grow visibility across Google search, AI answer engines (AEO), and Google Ads — delivered in days, not months.

Flint Digital was founded by Chris Whaley, an operator who built and ranked his own portfolio of businesses before starting the agency. The focus: making small businesses easy to find on Google and in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity).

## Services
- Websites & E-Commerce — hand-coded, fast, fully hosted; delivered in days.
- Search & Content (SEO) — keyword strategy, technical SEO, schema markup, content, and Google Business Profile optimization.
- AEO / AI Search Optimization — earning recommendations from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity.
- Google Paid Ads — Expert Mode campaigns with conversion tracking.
- Small Business AI Consulting.

## Pricing
- Website Build — $1,500 one-time.
- Hosting + Monitoring — $249/month.
- Content + Optimization — $649/month.
- Full-Stack Growth — $999/month.
All monthly plans are month-to-month with no long-term contract.
